Market today: Tech/chip names face headwinds. The Marvell/Lumentum deal is sparking "dot-com bubble" fears, directly impacting your concentrated book. Oracle's AI financing is also in play.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down 64.29% with a broken stop. SMH (-16.52%) and QQQI (-7.03%) are also "SELL" and near their stops. Remember margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: The fallout from the Marvell deal on the broader chip sector. Keep a close eye on your leveraged ETFs.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your deeply underwater and leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Your 64.29% loss is critical; the 200 stop is ineffective at 80.27. Re-evaluate this position and its stop immediately, or consider trimming.
SMH: Watch your 540 stop closely; it's near the current 531.25 price. Respect it if it breaks.
SOXS: Consider a tactical hedge with SOXS (inverse chip ETF) given negative chip news. Scanner entry 49.91-49.86, stop 49.42.
